description: This file is a server-side script for managing invoice templates in a web application, including loading, creating, updating, and deleting templates via API calls, and handling HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads invoice templates with pagination, filtering, and transforms the API response for the frontend.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new invoice template by sending a POST request with form data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing invoice template identified by ID, using form data to send a PUT request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an invoice template based on the ID obtained from form data via a DELETE request.
